ex.en: It is hard to keep our balance on icy streets.
ex.zh: 在結冰的街道上很難保持平衡。

ex.en: The icy road sparkled in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 結冰的路面在陽光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.
ex.zh: 路面結冰導致了許多事故。

ex.en: An icy wind blew into the room through the open window.
ex.zh: 一股寒風從開著的窗戶吹進屋裡。

ex.en: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
ex.zh: 一陣刺骨寒風讓我冷到骨子裡。

ex.en: She gave me an icy look.
ex.zh: 她冷冷地看了我一眼。

ex.en: His suggestion got an icy reception.
ex.zh: 他的提議受到冷淡的回應。

ex.en: Click the icon to open the app.
ex.zh: 點一下圖示就能開啟這個應用程式。

ex.en: Drag the icon to your desktop.
ex.zh: 把圖示拖到你的桌面上。

icon.zh: 偶像、代表性人物或事物

ex.en: She became a fashion icon in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 她在 1990 年代成為時尚偶像。

ex.en: The tower is an icon of the city.
ex.zh: 這座塔是這個城市的地標象徵。

ex.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
ex.zh: 羅傑在冰上滑倒，傷了腿。

ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
ex.zh: 冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of water with no ice?
ex.zh: 可以給我一杯不加冰的水嗎？

ex.en: I want a cup of iced tea.
ex.zh: 我要一杯冰紅茶。

ex.en: I'll have an iced coffee, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一杯冰咖啡。

ex.en: I never have an ice cream without feeling happy.
ex.zh: 我一吃冰淇淋就很開心。

ex.en: I've got to stop eating such sweet ice cream.
ex.zh: 我得戒掉吃這麼甜的冰淇淋。

ice.zh: break the ice：打破僵局、緩和氣氛

ex.en: He told a joke to break the ice.
ex.zh: 他講了個笑話來打破僵局。

ex.en: Games are a good way to break the ice at meetings.
ex.zh: 玩遊戲是會議上破冰的好方法。
